description: Weak, mixed unit. Its clearest trigger: the opponent has three stones in a four-cell window on the bottom row and I must block the empty bottom cell, which is not the centre column. I have no win of my own. Most other firing is in late-game boards with few open columns, and I found no board rule for it. Centre-column must-blocks and opponent double threats drive it strongly negative.
effect: Lowers the centre column (3) by about 4-11 points and moves that mass to other columns (seen in 4 positions). No effect when the move is already forced.
notes: Best dev F1 0.132 (P 0.26, R 0.09, AUROC 0.54); simulation share 0.22 with graded level (poisoned columns). Rejected: any must-block / threat above landing (F1 0.08), centre-full/anti-centre proxies (0.07-0.10). Activation depends on move order (3,4,2,5=0.0 vs 3,5,2,4=1.4 for the same board), and one-stone changes flip row-0 must-blocks from +5.5 to -3.8. Bulk of firing (0.8-1.7, late game) unexplained. Likely a mixture or near-random direction. Synthesis max 6.36 < dev max 10.02.
